title: auri insight
description: The auri insight catalog for A2UI: presenting a finding and reaching its evidence — insight cards, drill paths from aggregate to source, cluster and velocity pictures, and source audit with transcript. Domain-neutral: what a finding is ABOUT travels as data, never as a schema enum. Component contracts are renderer-agnostic; see prompt.md for the agent-facing pack.
instructions: Rules for emitting this catalog. 1) Every drillable element carries `subjectKind` + `subjectId` — the renderer merges them into drill and feedback action contexts automatically; never duplicate them into context yourself. `subjectKind` and `signalType` are FREE STRINGS in your own domain's words, not a fixed list. 2) `confidence` is a raw number 0..1; the renderer shows a qualitative band — never emit a percentage or a string. 3) Raw values on the wire: ISO 8601 windows, raw counts, raw amounts. Supporting figures go in `metrics` as {label, value, unit?, intent?} — `unit` takes an ISO 4217 code for money. Never pre-format a number or a date. 4) Feedback must visibly change something: bind a path the feedback action writes, so accepting or dismissing a finding is observable. Feedback that changes nothing teaches users their input is decorative.

headline.description: The claim, in one sentence. Required — it is the card's accessible name. The card reserves two lines for it, so write for two lines at most.

subjectKind.description: What kind of thing this insight is about. Required — it is merged into drill and feedback contexts.

subjectId.description: Stable id of the subject, e.g. 'cl-report-accuracy'. Required.

summary.description: One or two sentences of supporting evidence, written for humans.

signalType.description: What kind of signal this is, in YOUR domain's words — "churn_risk", "outage", "policy_drift", "fraud_pattern". Free text on purpose; a closed list would be one product's taxonomy. Keep the strings stable across a surface so they group and filter.

intent.description: Judgment of the insight; default 'neutral'. An alert is an insight whose intent earns 'bad'.

trend.description: Direction of the underlying signal — describes, never judges.

items.description: One figure supporting the finding. Raw values only — the renderer formats in the host locale.

label.description: What the figure is, e.g. "Cases" or "Revenue at risk".

value.description: The raw number. Bind with {"path": ...} if it changes.

unit.description: ISO 4217 code for money ("USD"), or a short unit ("ms", "%"). Same convention as ops Stat.

intent.description: Optional per-figure intent — this is why one array beats fixed props: each figure carries its own reading.

metrics.description: The figures behind the claim, as {label, value, unit?, intent?}. As many as the finding needs — an empty array collapses the row. Raw numbers only; the renderer formats them.

windowStart.description: ISO 8601 start of the observation window.

windowEnd.description: ISO 8601 end of the observation window.

confidence.description: Raw 0..1. Rendered as a qualitative band (low / medium / high) — a model emitting 0.87 claims precision it doesn't have, so the renderer never shows the number.

items.description: A short labelled facet of the finding, rendered as a chip.

count.description: Optional raw count; the renderer formats it.

tags.description: Facets of the finding as {label, count?} chips. Empty collapses the chip row.

drillAction.description: Fired when the user drills into the insight. subjectKind + subjectId are merged into its context automatically.

feedbackAction.description: Fired by the thumbs pair. subjectKind, subjectId, and verdict ('up' | 'down') are merged automatically. The card shows an acknowledged state itself; respond to a 'down' by de-emphasizing via the data model.

detailComponentId.description: ComponentId of extra content, rendered collapsed under the card.

label.description: What this recording is, e.g. 'Support call — Acme Corp, 14 Aug'. Required — the accessible name.

mediaUrl.description: URL of the recording (host-signed, short-lived is fine). Required. Never autoplays.

posterUrl.description: Poster image for video, shown before load.

durationSeconds.description: Raw duration. Supplying it lets the player reserve its scrubber layout before media metadata arrives — zero CLS.

captionsUrl.description: WebVTT captions URL. Captions are the requirement; the transcript is an enhancement.

transcript.description: Time-synced lines. Bind with {"path": ...} — transcription runs async, so an empty transcript is a common, designed state ('transcript still processing'), not an error.

seekAction.description: Optional: fired when the user seeks via a transcript line; startSeconds is merged into its context automatically.

label.description: The chart's title and accessible name. Required.

xLabel.description: X axis meaning, e.g. 'Support volume'. Required — an unlabelled axis is unreadable.

subjectKind.description: What the points are. Default 'account'; merged into pointAction context with the point's id.

id.description: The subject id this point drills to.

label.description: Human name, e.g. 'Acme Corp'. Required — points are read aloud, not just plotted.

dx.description: Momentum along x since the previous window. Raw signed number.

dy.description: Momentum along y since the previous window. Raw signed number.

weight.description: Sizes the point, e.g. by revenue. Raw number.

points.description: The accounts as points with momentum vectors. Bind with {"path": ...} to stream.

pointAction.description: Fired on point activation. subjectKind, subjectId (the point's id), pointLabel, x, and y are merged into its context automatically.

label.description: Title and accessible name, e.g. 'Accounts at risk, by reason'. Required.

size.description: How many accounts share the reason. Raw count.

reason.description: The shared risk reason, written for humans — the thing that makes the group actionable. Required.

clusters.description: Groups of accounts that share a risk reason. The reason is the point — it is what makes the group actionable.

clusterAction.description: Fired on cluster activation. subjectKind 'cluster', subjectId (the cluster's id), and reason are merged into its context automatically.

title.description: Breadcrumb text and the level's accessible name.

componentId.description: ComponentId of the level's content, already on the surface.

levels.description: The drill path, surface first. Each level names a component already on the surface.

activeIndex.description: Data binding for the visible depth, always {"path": ...}. Push a level by writing the index with updateDataModel — never by re-sending the stack. Required.

dismissAction.description: Optional: fired when the user dismisses the whole stack.
